Total net sales for FY2024 are $352.9 billion; the previously reported $391.0 billion is not to be relied upon. Revised statements and non-reliance notice inside.", "page": "SEC EDGAR — Full Filing View
Apple Inc. (CIK 0000320193) — Form 10-K/A (Amendment No. 1)
Fiscal Year Ended September 28, 2024 | Filed 2025-01-17 | Accession 0000320193-25-000011

EXPLANATORY NOTE
This Amendment No. 1 on Form 10-K/A amends the Annual Report on Form 10-K of Apple Inc. for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, originally filed on November 1, 2024. The Amendment restates the Company's consolidated financial statements for fiscal 2024 to correct the recognition of certain revenue under third-party channel and marketing arrangements. Accordingly, the consolidated financial statements and the related report of the independent registered public accounting firm included in the original Form 10-K should no longer be relied upon.

RESTATEMENT SUMMARY
- Revenue of $38.1 billion recognized in fiscal 2024 under certain channel-partner arrangements did not meet the criteria for revenue recognition under ASC 606 and has been reversed.
- The reversal is presented as a reduction of total net sales; there is no corresponding adjustment to cash provided by operating activities.
- Net income is unchanged at $93.7 billion; diluted EPS is unchanged at $6.08.

CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS (RESTATED, USD millions)
Total net sales, fiscal 2024 (as restated) ....... 352,900
Total net sales, fiscal 2024 (as originally reported) ....... 391,035
Total net sales, fiscal 2023 ....... 383,285
Net income ....... 93,736
Diluted EPS (USD/share) ....... 6.08

NET SALES BY CATEGORY (RESTATED, USD millions)
iPhone .......................... 181,200
Mac ............................. 27,000
iPad ............................ 24,000
Wearables, Home & Accessories ... 33,400
Services ........................ 87,300
Total net sales ................. 352,900

NET SALES BY REGION (RESTATED, USD millions)
Americas 148,300 | Europe 94,100 | Greater China 60,200 | Japan 24,600 | Rest of Asia Pacific 25,700
Total net sales ................. 352,900

ITEM 9A — CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES
Management concluded that a material weakness existed in the Company's revenue-recognition controls relating to channel-partner arrangements as of September 28, 2024. Remediation is underway.
